slides.headline: 7 SIGNS YOUR FOCUS IS LEAKING
slides.sub: and the daily patch that holds it

slides.headline: 1. You reread the same line three times
slides.body: Attention slips and rejoins without you noticing. Trained attention catches the slip early.

slides.headline: 2. You reach for the phone mid-sentence
slides.body: An open loop your brain runs on autopilot. The patch is noticing the reach before the tap.

slides.headline: 3. Tabs multiply, tasks do not
slides.body: Each open tab is a small hole in the bucket. Close to one and the leak slows.

slides.headline: 4. You forget why you walked in
slides.body: The doorway wipes short-term context. A trained memory carries it across the threshold.

slides.headline: 5. Afternoons feel like fog
slides.body: Focus drains fastest after lunch. A short reset refills it better than caffeine.

slides.headline: 6 and 7. Names vanish, ideas slip
slides.body: Working memory holds only a few items under load. Training raises the ceiling.

slides.headline: The 10-minute patch
slides.body: A short daily attention drill closes the holes so the bucket finally holds.
